Girdwood Public Safety Advisory Committee Regular Meeting
                            October 13, 2026
                              Minutes Draft

This meeting will be held via Teams with in-person attendance at the Girdwood Community Room, 250 Egloff Dr.

The Girdwood Public Safety Advisory Committee operates under the Girdwood Public Meetings Standards of Conduct.

7PM Call to order Debra Croghan, Co-chair
Roll call: attending are Tim Astle (TA); Cody Rice (CR), Debra Croghan (DC)
Luke Niedrinhaus is unable to attend.
Quorum confirmed
GBOS: Amanda Tuttle, Police, Roads and Utilities Chair

Agenda approval for Oct 13 2026 meeting    TA/CR         Assent
Minutes approval from Aug 11 2026 meeting  TA/DC         Assent

Announcements/Introductions/Presentation:
Old Business:

        1. PSAC filled position & Welcome Cody Rice

        2.  Progress with Traffic and Traffic control study of Hightower Road including Alyeska Highway
         No update.

        3.  Update on DOT contact and request for attendance to discuss local issues (Tuttle/Croghan)
         Amanda updates that at GBOS meeting in August Sen. Giessel and Rep. Holland offered to review and
            sign on to letter from GBOS to the AKDOT Commissioner. A few other topics have been added, she plans
            to provide draft letter to GBOS at their meeting next week. It is unclear when the letter will be approved
          by GBOS and reviewed by legislators, compared to possible change in leadership based on election in
          November.

        4.  Public Safety Contract after 2027: Ideas to be considered in next contract cycle (starting Jan 1 2028)
          Items brought up previously for possible inclusion in upcoming contract are:
             •   Potential for enforcement of Municipal code – costs associated with this will need to be reviewed.
             •   Longer contract period (5 years with an extension for 2 years.
             •   Monthly report include general area of Girdwood (i.e. old townsite, new townsite, resort area,
                 residential)
             Staff will provide analysis of similar communities and what they pay for law enforcement.
         AT requests data on response times in this analysis.

        5.  Ongoing concerns:
               Parking concerns (Brewery, Forest Fair, Winter overflow):
       Motion:
      PSAC moves to have GBOS write a Resolution of Support to MOA Traffic Department requesting double-sided
      no parking signs are installed on Davos Road.
       Motion by CR/TA
       Motion carries 3-0

              Turnagain Arm boat launch for first responders:
        This item has moved to DOT liaison letter topic

              Old Girdwood Flood Hazard due to inadequate levy at the trestle.
       Motion:
      PSAC moves to have GBOS write a Resolution of Support to declare a temporary moratorium on approval of
       stream setback variances in Girdwood, pending outcome of Engineer Review of discharge volume at the levy
        at the trestle and identification of resources to be used to protect Old Girdwood in the event of failure of the
        levy.
       Motion by CR/2nd DC
       Motion carries 3-0
             Girdwood Public Safety Advisory Committee is a sub-committee to the Girdwood Board of Supervisors

                                                                                         1

AWWU treatment plant violations
        Violations were discussed at September 2026 GBOS meeting with AWWU presenting in that the long-term
        violation was actually a one-time, short-term violation that was corrected immediately. Correction was not
       reported by State to EPA correctly, so the paperwork error appeared as a long-term violation.

     GBOS has a plant tour of the AWWU facility on MON Oct 19. Waiver is required to attend – Cody Rice requests
        waiver. Other PSAC members are not available.

               Alyeska Resort parking concerns high volume weekend winter traffic and Blueberry Festival
        Staff has been in touch with Alyeska regarding parking concerns. In past years there have been free chairlift
        rides and other efforts to encourage parking at the Daylodge for this Hotel-based event. In recent years
       Resort has removed some parking capacity with the construction of Little Bears at the hotel lot and the
        construction of new condos taking over prior parking in the Daylodge lot. Recommend that Alyeska do more to
      manage parking. PSAC plans to continue discussion at their December meeting and be prepared to engage
        with Resort on this item before Spring Carnival.

     New Business:
        6.  Discuss any new Girdwood public safety concerns (see meeting packet)
            Vehicles driving over the curb at the Merc: GBOS will discuss at their Oct meeting. Request is to fund
            bollards to impede this activity.

           Hightower Home house variance for fence may impede sightlines for traffic and wildlife. Item is before p&z
          and has been in meeting packet at LUC and GBOS in September.

          Girdwood Airport Emergency Plan: see meeting packet, emergency plan is responsibility of Fire Dept and
            Airport Manager for unmanned airports.

Reports/Ongoing items:
        7.  Review recent/upcoming community events (see meeting packet)
           Kids and Cops Oct 17 at the Ice Cream Shop time 11A-2P: DC and CR plan to attend
           Coffee with cops Nov 21 at the Grind Time 9A-12P: DC and CR plan to attend

        8.  Other Community relations opportunities: No action discussed.
         PSAC member ride along with WPD
          Outreach via community resources: Newspaper; Newsletters; Clinic; Other

        9.  Roundtable comments from the PSAC board
           Wildland Fire Assessment has caused insurance companies to require significant clearing. Blanket
          assessment does not account for Girdwood rainforest climate and wetlands.

       10. Next meeting dates
          Dec 15    7PM: Moved to Dec 8
         2027 dates Feb 9, April 13, June 8

Public Safety Reports:
WPD Update (WPD Chief Andre Achee) – review most recent stats
GFR Update (Chief Michelle Weston) – request written report
GBOS Public Safety Supervisor report: Rules and procedures update ongoing, encourage PSAC to review and make
comments. Rules should be posted for the Oct 19 meeting with comments needed by Nov 16 meeting. Earliest
adoption would be Nov 16.

Public Comment: None.
Adjourn 8:55PM
